description: Source code for managing Lua script caching within the mod_magnet_cache module of a web server, including script initialization, loading, and cache management functions.

classes.name: script
classes.description: Represents a Lua script with associated metadata and state.

classes.name: script_cache
classes.description: Manages a cache of script objects for efficient reuse.

methods.name: script_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new script object.

methods.name: script_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a script object.

methods.name: script_cache_init
methods.description: Initializes a new script cache (commented out in code).

methods.name: script_cache_free_data
methods.description: Frees all scripts in the cache.

methods.name: script_cache_load_script
methods.description: Loads a script from disk into the cache, using Lua's loadbuffer.

methods.name: script_cache_new_script
methods.description: Creates a new script object and adds it to the cache.

methods.name: script_cache_get_script
methods.description: Retrieves a script from cache by name, or creates it if not found.

methods.name: script_cache_check_script
methods.description: Checks if the script needs reloading based on file changes and reloads if necessary.
